SSRF policy rejects an IPv4 loopback address embedded in an IPv6 literal

```swift title="Swift"
import Crawlberg

do {
    let engineConfig = try crawlConfigFromJson("{\"ssrf\":{\"deny_private\":true},\"ssrf_deny_private_explicit\":true}")
    let engineObj = try createEngine(config: engineConfig)
    let url = "http://[::ffff:127.0.0.1]/"
    _ = try await Crawlberg.scrape(engine: engineObj, url: url)
} catch {
    let _errorMessage = String(describing: error)
    let _errorType = String(describing: type(of: error))
    XCTAssertTrue(_errorMessage.contains("ssrf_policy_violation") || _errorType.contains("ssrf_policy_violation"), "expected error to mention \"ssrf_policy_violation\", got message: \(_errorMessage), type: \(_errorType)")
}
```
